_comment: T-318, the recap screen's text (HUD and menus, Content, 'Recap screen'); T-320 reads it, no text in code. Every new line scored 8 or more in the style loop. Keys: title.<ending> for win, time_up, wreck; heading.<section>; button.continue and button.close (the X's accessible label); tier ('{tier}' is 1 to 8); enemy.<id>; weapon.<id>; trick.<id> (reused word for word from the trick popups, game/scripts/hud/trick_popups.gd TEXTS); weapon names marked reused come from the level-up cards' get_<weapon>.title (game/scripts/ui/level_up_texts.gd).
peak_value_comment: T-512: the recap's peak combo value, beside heading.combo: the run's highest combo multiplier, two decimals (for example x4.25). Replaces the peak live viewers number.
